reason: I'd actually download it, because walking in with something on paper so I don't get the 'just lose weight' speech again is exactly what I want. But my first summary is free and I haven't even been diagnosed yet, so there's nothing for me to pay for this month.
objection: I'm 19 on about $23k and already paying for supplements, and my period app tracks cycles for free. I'm not sure a one-page summary makes a doctor take me more seriously, and I'd want to see that happen before paying for Pro.
would_change_my_mind: If the free summary actually got me taken seriously, like a doctor ordering the bloodwork or ultrasound instead of brushing me off, I'd pay the $7.99 for my next appointment.
